seoTitle: robots.txt Comment Annotator: Plain-English Rule Notes
metaDescription: Add a comment above every robots.txt rule that explains in plain words which URLs it blocks or allows. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Writes a short explanation above each Allow and Disallow line.
why:
A robots.txt full of patterns like /*?sort= or /*.pdf$ is a mystery to the next person who edits it. Comments help, but few people write them.

The annotator reads each rule and adds a comment such as Blocks everything inside the folder /admin/ or Blocks any URL ending in .pdf. Existing comments and lines with their own comment are left alone.
howTo: Edit comments that are not quite right.
Keep the annotated file as your source.

faq.a: No, it only adds comment lines.
They are generated from the pattern shape. Odd wildcard mixes get a generic description, so read them.

faq.q: Do comments increase the file size?
faq.a: Yes, slightly. Mind the 500 KiB limit.
